subject: Dedicated capacity demo coordination — Orion Analytics intake

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionanalytics.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inbound: Dedicated capacity demo request — Orion Analytics

Hi Ben + Markus,

We signed up via the self‑serve flow and selected 'Request Dedicated Capacity demo'. We're evaluating dedicated inference for a customer-facing feature and need to validate throughput/latency.

High-level context:
- Target daily throughput: ~2M tokens/day (burst concurrency up to 200 reqs/sec)
- Latency SLO: 99th <= 200ms for short responses (~150 tokens)
- Sensitive data: PII involved — we'll need VPC/private deployment discussion

We've attached a small sample of typical request sequences (workload_sample.csv) and a short architecture note.

Can you run a slot availability check and propose 2x 45‑minute windows in the next week? We're in ET (UTC-4). Preferred: mornings (10–12 ET) window.

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform
Orion Analytics
liam.oconnor@orionanalytics.com
Attachments: workload_sample.csv (csv)
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=orion-demo-doc
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound: Dedicated capacity demo request — Orion Analytics

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the sample.

Quick intake and next steps:
1) Match on throughput & latency: Monica (cc) will run a quick sizing exercise using the sample and follow up with estimated GPU sizing.
2) Security/prep: We'll cover deployment modes (Hosted vs Private VPC vs On‑prem) in the call. If you can share security contacts, we can include them on the invite.
3) Proposed slots (ET):
   - Thu 16 Sep, 10:30–11:15 ET
   - Fri 17 Sep, 11:00–11:45 ET

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and a short agenda.

If those work, we'll send a calendar invite and include a brief pre‑demo checklist.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionanalytics.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@orionanalytics.com, security@orionanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Inbound: Dedicated capacity demo request — Orion Analytics

Ben — Thu 16 Sep 10:30 ET works for us. Please include Monica and whoever will speak to deployment options.

Pre-demo asks from our engineering org:
- Can you confirm the expected tail latency at 200 reqs/sec for a 150-token response on the model family you plan to demo? (If not exact, a ballpark on p99).
- Any constraints on concurrent KV cache sizes / context length? Our requests have a ~4k token context on average.
- We'll share a stripped dataset; can you confirm how Redwood handles PII during the demo (redaction or ephemeral storage)?

Looping in our ops/security teams — they'll likely have a short checklist for the Private deployment conversation.

Thanks,
Liam

Great — Thu 16 Sep 10:30 ET is locked on our side. Calendar invite + Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0example

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Please upload the stripped sample to the Drive link you shared (we have it already — thanks). If you can include a representative token distribution, that helps our sizing run.
- Expected avg/peak token lengths (already noted: avg ~150; you mentioned 4k context — please confirm how often)
- Security contacts + SOC2 attestation questions — Monica will bring the security pack and cover PII handling (demo environment is ephemeral; we don't persist inputs beyond the session unless requested).

Agenda (45 min):
- 5m intro & goals (Ben)
- 15m sizing + model selection (Monica)
- 15m live run with your sample (Monica/Markus)
- 10m deployment options & next steps (Ben)
